meta.echelle: 1 unit ~ 1 minute of travel on foot (non-metric, code use only)

lieux.description_narrative: Rolling chalk downs and dark woods on the border of fae influence. The Veil gathers here when the Court is near.

aretes.description: West along the old drover's road, past the split oak
North-east, following the dry-stone wall until it ends, then into the reeds

lieux.description_narrative: Seven stone buildings at a ford. The mist gathers at the treeline each night and retreats at dawn — a little later each morning.

aretes.description: South-west, out of the reeds, back to the dry-stone wall
West through Hunger Wood — dense, fog-filled, easy to lose the path

lieux.description_narrative: A brackish marsh. The air smells of iron and old lavender. Fog-wraiths first appear here. A faceless standing stone marks the fae boundary at its centre.
A village swallowed by the Veil. Silence between heartbeats, cold lamplight, the smell of wet chalk.

aretes.description: East along the old drover's road, past the split oak
Cross the village square — two minutes in daylight, five in Veil-fog
North through the village, past the tithe barn, to the edge of the wood

lieux.description_narrative: Long stone building doubling as shelter and Warden meeting room. Cold-iron tools on the wall. The last safe room in Thornwick.
A deep stone well in the village square. The water tastes faintly of iron. The Charter is hidden in a sealed pouch behind a loose stone at its base.

aretes.description: Deeper into the forest — no path, follow the cold draft; only possible at the new moon or by fae invitation

lieux.description_narrative: An enormous ancient oak. Wide enough for three to stand inside. Bargain-marks etched in the bark. The gateway inside opens at the new moon.

aretes.description: Through the gateway — only accessible at new moon or by invitation; time passes differently inside

lieux.description_narrative: Cold marble pavilions hung with silver lanterns. Time passes wrong here. The Lady of Sighs holds court on a throne of antlers and promises.
